I hit the tool-call ceiling mid-slice. Here is where things stand — say continue and I'll resume from exactly this point and package the archive.

First: a correction to the record
Your memory of this project said Slice 47 and 1166 tests. The tree says Slice 51 and 1223 tests, all green. I reconstructed the working tree from dump.txt — 360 file records, 359 matching their SHA-256 exactly (the one exception is LICENSE, which the dump elides by design since Slice 46). claude-terminal.txt confirms total: 1223, failed: 0 twice, seventeen E2E scenarios passing, every local CI gate green.

So Slices 47–51 shipped: section resequencing, item resequencing, the guest heading description, MenuGrouping plus the kitchen's grouped 86 panel, and Stage 4a (the menu_item_image schema, ImageFormat, ADR-0015). Stage 3 is closed. This is Slice 52 and it is Stage 4b.

What Slice 52 is
The carried item named in Slice 51 was blunt: no surface reads or writes a picture. Stage 4b discharges it.

The open design question is settled. The plan named two options for getting a file into a static-SSR page — a multipart form posting to a minimal API endpoint, or making a page interactive. There is a third that neither named and it is better than both: a plain <form enctype="multipart/form-data" @formname=… @onsubmit=…> posts to the page itself, and the handler reads HttpContext.Request.Form.Files. Blazor's static form dispatch reads Request.Form anyway, so antiforgery stays the framework's job, post/redirect/get is unchanged, and the page stays static SSR.

The size cap stays in one place. No transport ceiling is restated in C# — Kestrel's existing 30 MB body limit already bounds every POST this application accepts, so the picture form introduces no new number. A four-megabyte phone photo is refused by §8.2's named CHECK and reported by constraint name, exactly as designed.

A finding: F-102. AttachMenuItemImageOutcome's summary says "Six answers rather than a boolean" — and the enum has seven members, three lines below the sentence counting them. Found by reading the type in order to write the surface that renders one sentence per member (F-93's timing, third occurrence). Repaired by deleting the number per F-77, not correcting it.

src/MyRestaurant.WebApplication/Menu/MenuItemImageEndpoints.cs — new: MenuImageRoutes (keyed on the image identifier, which is what makes immutable truthful), MenuItemImageUpload (field name + accept derived from ImageFormat.RecognisedContentTypes, so F-80's vocabulary is not declared a third time), and the anonymous GET endpoint.
MenuWorkflow.cs — both verbs behind IMenuWorkflow, publishing on a written row only, keyed on the two success outcomes rather than "not a refusal".
OrdersServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, Program.cs, MenuItemImages.cs (F-102).
